image_description: A side-front view of a compact minibus parked on a paved street. The vehicle has a two-tone color scheme (beige/cream lower body, dark brown/black upper front) with red and white graphics along the side. It features a large windshield, a row of passenger windows, and visible wheels. There is a tripod stand in the foreground near the front wheel. The background shows urban buildings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, split-pane windshield is visible at the front, and a continuous row of rectangular passenger windows runs along the side body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a standing passenger cabin. A sliding door track and handle are visible just behind the front wheel arch, indicating a front-mid entrance.
The vertical seam and recessed handle behind the front wheel indicate a sliding door mechanism typical of this class.
The short hood/bonnet ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, distinct from cab-over designs.

Based on the window count (approx 5-6 side windows) and body length, the capacity aligns with the 4-10+ passenger minibus category.
